formulae.H_risk: p_m=max_j BinomCDF(K_mj;A_mj,alpha), with p_mj=1 when A_mj=0; apply Holm across M=12 at delta_r

selection: For each procedure, select the passing proposal-feasible member with the greatest positive coverage LCB. Use the frozen tie rule. Refuse if none passes.

metrics.ECA: certified indicator multiplied by selected coverage LCB; zero for refusal or proposal infeasibility
metrics.certification_rate: certified model cells divided by all 30 planned cells
metrics.CondCertCov: mean selected coverage LCB among certified cells with the certified denominator
metrics.S_minus_B: paired mean ECA difference; client-count division effect
metrics.H_minus_S: paired mean ECA difference; Holm residual effect
metrics.H_minus_B: paired mean ECA difference; total headline contrast

PASS_FULL_PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMATION: H certifies at least 6 of 30 models
H certification appears in both architectures
H certification appears in at least 3 of 5 class splits
mean H ECA is at least 0.05
mean S-minus-B ECA is at least 0.01
architecture-specific mean S-minus-B is nonnegative for both architectures
each architecture contains at least one strict positive S-minus-B cell
all integrity and replay checks pass
decision_gates.PASS_CORE_ONLY: absolute H utility gates pass but at least one S-minus-B gain gate fails
decision_gates.VALID_NEGATIVE: complete valid experiment in which at least one absolute H utility gate fails
decision_gates.HOLD_INCOMPLETE: any registered model or verifier outcome is missing
decision_gates.INVALID: any protocol, leakage, hash, implementation, evidence-equality, or count-ordering breach

descriptive_bootstrap.resampling: paired resampling of the three training seeds within each fixed architecture-by-split stratum
descriptive_bootstrap.scope: conditional training-RNG variation; not theorem confidence or source-population inference

mandatory_reporting: primary and secondary results kept distinct
